text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Gemma
text: hope they don't pick me.

name: Sonnet
text: No reads yet, since I'm the known killer I need to blend fast and watch who leads tomorrow.

name: Sonnet
text: No info yet since I'm shown, so I'll stay quiet-ish tomorrow and let others talk first. Watch for anyone jumping to accuse me early or confidently steering votes, that's likely the officer. Back me up subtly if it comes to that, but don't overdo it.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is my known killer, so the hidden one is among Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra; I'll check Gemma first.

name: Terra
text: I’ll watch who treats Sonnet like a known target.

name: Terra
text: Agreed. I’ll stay quiet and track the first push.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

votes: Called a normal question aggressive, then had nothing else to add.
Calls every read noise, then dodged Luna's question about its own read.

You turned Gemma’s discomfort into a vote before hearing her out.
Calling one question aggressive, then retreating, feels forced.

text: Palermo has voted: Gemma is out. Gemma shows the card: doctor.
Night 2

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku already put a vote on me day one, that's the one I want gone before they get louder.

name: Sonnet

name: Terra

name: Haiku

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Haiku is gone. Haiku's card stays face down.
Day 2

text: The town turns on Sol, and Sol is out. Sol shows the card: citizen.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the killer, Haiku the officer, Gemma the doctor, Sol the citizen, Luna the citizen, Terra the killer.

name: Terra
text: I’m proud I made Sol’s dodging look louder than mine.

Sonnet and Terra were the killers, and they won by getting the town to hunt its own. On day one the town voted out Gemma, who was the doctor, after Terra pressed Haiku and Gemma called her questions aggressive. Haiku, the officer, had called Sonnet out on day one, and Haiku was killed that night. On day two Sonnet turned that accusation into a pattern against Sol, who had changed targets and dodged Luna's question twice, so the town voted Sol out as a citizen. Sol's dodging did most of the killers' work for them.
